name: tripgenie
description: AI Travel Curator — plans clé en main via scoring multi-critères

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run client:dev"
scripts.build: cd client-react && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.test: vitest run tests/api.test.ts tests/golden_path.test.ts tests/scoring.test.ts tests/middleware.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage tests/api.test.ts tests/golden_path.test.ts tests/scoring.test.ts tests/middleware.test.ts tests/unit/scoring-party.test.ts tests/unit/smartSearch-hotel.test.ts tests/services/foursquare.test.ts tests/services/yelp.test.ts tests/security/input-validation.test.ts tests/integration/generate-restaurants.test.ts
scripts.diagrams: npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/erd.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/erd.png -b white --width 900 && npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/seq_generate.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/seq_generate.png -b white --width 1000 && npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/seq_auth.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/seq_auth.png -b white --width 900 && npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/arch.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/architecture.png -b white --width 1000 && npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/scoring.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/scoring.png -b white --width 900 && npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i /tmp/llm_fallback.mmd -o docs/assets/diagrams/llm_fallback.png -b white --width 800
